title: Contents Packout & Storage Furniture Reset Line Pricing
content:
Contents Packout & Storage furniture reset pricing for Partial Contents Packout, Full Contents Packout, High-Value Contents Packout and Commercial Contents and Records Recovery jobs.

1. **Pieces set.** The pieces set are the furniture item quantities on the job's packout lines.
2. **Line.** The standard furniture reset line is the pieces set times the tier's furniture reset rate, rounded to the cent, half up.
3. **Combination.** The amounts are combined in one order: the rate per piece is the tier's furniture reset rate with any percentage applied first and then every add per piece added; that rate per piece is multiplied by the pieces set; every amount figured per item or per crew is added to that product, and the total is rounded once to the cent, half up, as the line amount.
4. **Rounding.** Half up is applied with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added before rounding, so that a figure lying on a half cent always rounds up.
5. **Reach.** For the furniture reset line of a return, and only for that line, the amount is figured as stated here; the pack-back box line and the truck-load line of a return remain under their own rules, and any other pack-back line is still billed per box and per furniture item reset at the tier's rates, rounded to the cent, half up.

The pieces counted are the quantities on the furniture packing lines (blanket wrap and move out per furniture item) booked on the job; the furniture reset rate is the tier figure on the product's pack-back rates table.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** 37 furniture items packed out, at a reset rate taken as 20.00 for the illustration (not a tier figure): 37 times 20.00 is 740.00.
